title: Shaping Foreign Policy in a Less Predictable World
what_it_is: Shaping Foreign Policy in a Less Predictable World

sections.label: Foreign policy and Singapore's survival
sections.summary: The speaker argues that Singapore's ability to navigate foreign policy is more critical than ever for its survival.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Therefore, reverberations at a distance are more acutely and easily felt than before, sometimes, almost as if we experience it for ourselves first-hand.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Therefore, I argue, Mr Speaker, our ability to navigate our relationships and approaches in foreign policy are more critical than ever for Singapore's survival if we were to ride the waves of the future, catch the wind and sail our next lap as a nation.

sections.label: Three suggestions for foreign policy
sections.summary: The speaker puts forward three suggestions for the Ministry to consider in furthering Singapore's foreign policy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Through this Adjournment Motion, I put forward three suggestions for the Ministry to consider in its efforts to further foreign policy for our country.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: First, we need to and must engage our citizens better in the exercise of our foreign policy, broadly, for two reasons.

sections.label: Citizens strengthen overseas engagements
sections.summary: The speaker states that overseas engagements are more effective and resilient when harnessed with citizens' potential, networks and awareness.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The second reason is that our engagements overseas can only be more effective and resilient when harnessed with the potential of our citizens, their networks and their awareness of opportunities for the country.

sections.label: Deliberate citizen engagement on foreign policy
sections.summary: The speaker says citizen engagement on foreign policy must be done more deliberately to share, educate and widen understanding of Singapore's positions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Citizen engagement on our foreign policy needs to be done more deliberately in order to share, educate and achieve a wider understanding at the level of every citizen on why Singapore takes certain positions and decisions on the global stage.

sections.label: Differing while holding to values
sections.summary: The speaker says Singapore must be ready to differ from others and, over transgressions of international law, rebuke and hold parties accountable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: When this happens at the level of countries, we must be ready to differ from others and continue to align consistently with our values as we have on many occasions as a country on the international stage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I would also stretch it to say that in the context of transgressions over international law and any travesty of justice, we must owe it to our values and principles to not only express our dismay but to rebuke, to fervently object and to hold parties accountable in proportion to the actions in question.

sections.label: Singapore as honest broker
sections.summary: The speaker says Singapore is well poised for leadership, arbitration and mediation, and can be the honest broker when giants cannot agree.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Thirdly, my view is that Singapore is well poised for a role in leadership, arbitration and mediation in global affairs today and this is something Singapore should continue to hone and position itself to do better in.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Like the same yacht in the open sea, Singapore makes no seismic wave in the global order through its land size or natural resources.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: However, we have the prospect of being the honest broker in the room when giants cannot agree and the testament of our ability lies in how efficiently we do business and run our country, how we continue to be fair and consistent in our stated positions about issues and how serious we are about wanting peace and security for the world.

sections.label: Forum of Small States chairmanship
sections.summary: Singapore's chairmanship of the Forum of Small States shows utility in advancing smaller states' interests in an unpredictable world.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Our chairmanship of the Forum of Small States that we helped initiate, for example, can and has shown the utility in rallying for the unique concerns and advancing the interests of smaller states in an increasingly unpredictable world.

sections.label: Engaging citizens in foreign policy
sections.summary: Singapore can engage citizens better in foreign policy and use its size and standing to shape a better world.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Citizens do take an interest in how Singapore positions itself today vis-à-vis the uncertain global state of affairs and they are confronted with it more directly than ever before.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I believe we can and must engage citizens better as part of our foreign policy strategy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding the chaotic nature of the world today, at this stage of our development as a country, Singapore also has an opportunity to make a difference and shape the world for the better.

sentences.speaker: Dr Syed Harun Alhabsyi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: We can use our size and nimbleness to our strength, lean on our good standing as an honest broker and concerned citizen of the world and seize the opportunity to make a difference and influence for a better world and for generations to come.

sections.label: Dangerous world for small states
sections.summary: The world has become more dangerous for small states, with wars in Ukraine and the Middle East and wider conflagration risk.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The world has certainly become far more dangerous and far more inimical to small states.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: There are tragic wars going on in Ukraine and in the Middle East with horrendous civilian casualties and there is an elevated risk of a wider conflagration.

sections.label: Protecting independence and essential supplies
sections.summary: Singapore aims to protect its independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and secure essential supplies and open air and sea lanes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: First, to protect our Independence, our sovereignty and our territorial integrity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Second, to secure access to essential supplies – water, energy, food – in fact, almost everything we consume; and to keep the air and sea lanes of communication open.

sections.label: Positions on Ukraine and Israel-Hamas
sections.summary: Singapore took categorical positions on Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the Israel-Hamas conflict, urging a humanitarian ceasefire and hostage release.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: For instance, we had to take a categorical position on Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: It was a clear violation of the UN Charter and if the world accepts that a large neighbour, citing historical errors and crazy decisions, can intervene militarily in the affairs of a smaller neighbour, that is a world which is very dangerous for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: More recently, the appalling human tragedy of the Israel-Hamas conflict has elicited the shock, horror and anger in all of us.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We had to take a categorical stand against acts of terror which were committed on 7 October because if someone launched a thousand missiles in Bukit Panjang, an insurgent force in Woodlands and took 240 Singaporean hostage, you know we would have to respond.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Even as we asserted the right of self-defence, we also told the Israelis – and some Members of Parliament were with me when we went to both the Arab countries and to Israel – we said that your military response has gone too far and we need an immediate humanitarian ceasefire, and we need the safe and immediate, and unconditional release of all hostages.
